meaning: Repositories on which this system may create upstream PRs and issues without a per-action instruction, only when every gate passes (reviewer calibration PASSED; single owner per (repository, effect) under the TC-002 disposition; no duplicate; the first PR on a repository opened as a draft for owner review). Empty means nothing upstream is authorized. Only the owner adds entries.
note: Listing a repository authorizes nothing by itself: every gate must also pass, and reviewer calibration is NOT_PASSED (TC-007). Issues on these repositories are not listed (legacy funnel / TC-010a).
